captions: {city} averages {self_value} relative humidity. {difference} Humidity is the single condition mould cannot do without, so a damper-than-average climate raises the baseline risk for every property in it.

Air in {city}, {SS} holds more moisture than most of {state}: {self_value} against {benchmark_value} statewide. {difference} That shows up as slower drying and a shorter window between a leak and visible growth.
{difference} {city} sits at {self_value} where the wider state sees {benchmark_value} — enough to change how quickly a small moisture problem becomes a remediation job.
